task.title: Square root: the incremental integer square-root routine

located_defect.declaration: SqrtFailureBoundary.ProgramCorrect (the program prog against the specification R)
located_defect.lean_text:
abbrev R (x y : Nat) : Prop := y * y ≤ x ∧ x < (y + 1) * (y + 1)
def prog : Nat → Nat
  | 0 => 0
  | n + 1 =>
      let b := prog n
      if n + 1 ≤ (b + 1) * (b + 1) then b else b + 1
def ProgramCorrect : Prop := ∀ x : Nat, R x (prog x)
located_defect.description: The extracted program (stored source lines 0066-0072) is claimed to compute the integer square root, i.e. to satisfy R on every input; that universal claim is the located defect. Change only the recursive step (the guard comparison and/or the two branch values) so that the program meets the unchanged specification R on every natural input, and prove it; there is no separate target theorem for this record.

task.allowed_edit: Replace the hole in `step` by one expression of the form `if <comparison in n and b> then <value> else <value>` (values are expressions in n and b; exactly one `if`; no call to prog or progC, no match/let); nothing else in the fixed part may change. The specification R, the recursion shape (progC 0 = 0, progC (n+1) from progC n by one comparison and two branch values) and the domain (all natural inputs, no precondition) are fixed. Do not redefine R, prog or ProgramCorrect; no instances, notations, macros, axioms or exports.
task.challenged_passage: 0066-0072 prog :: Int → Int / prog 0 = 0 / prog n = let a = n - 1 ; b = prog a in if a + 1 <= (b + 1) * (b + 1) then b else b + 1

notes: Endpoint = universal obligation (change_incorrect_program_preserving_spec); the final role restates it because validate.py reports endpoint_final failed when no final role exists (README says it may be absent).

Declaration names must not contain an apostrophe: validate.py's #print axioms parser cannot read such names and reports them as not_reported (axioms check fails); the template therefore uses progC, not prog'.
Nonvacuity is `∃ x, progC x ≠ prog x` (the program was changed), leak-free; the witness input 1 and the value check R 1 (progC 1) live in AGREE.lean (agree_1).
